post.summary: Estimate image credits without submitting a generation
post.description: Validates image parameters and returns the credits that a generation request would reserve. It does not create a task.

Synchronous OpenAI Images-compatible response. Idempotency-Key is required. When the synchronous wait budget expires, the API returns 202 with the durable task and a Location header instead of creating a second operation.

post.description: The entries below are request templates, not values for a mode field and not all mutually exclusive. The API has no mode field: it infers reference inputs from uploaded multipart fields. No-reference requests use application/json; requests with reference media use multipart/form-data. Seedance 2.5 and Seedance 2.0 can combine image, video, and audio references; Kling O3 Omni accepts up to seven images, start/end frames, or one video plus up to four images; FLUX 3 Video supports either start/end frames or one video continuation reference; MiniMax H3 can combine image and audio references. Frame inputs are exclusive with all other reference media. Grok Imagine 1.5 is image-to-video only: start_frame is required and end_frame is unsupported.

x-generation-modes.name: No reference
x-generation-modes.rule: Do not send image, start_frame, end_frame, video, or audio.

x-generation-modes.name: Image reference
x-generation-modes.rule: Cannot be combined with start_frame or end_frame. Seedance 2.5 accepts up to 30 images. Veo 3.1 fixes size=1280x720 and duration=8. Kling O3 Omni accepts seven images, or four when a video reference is also present.

x-generation-modes.name: Start/end frame

model_exceptions.grok-imagine-1.5: start_frame is required and end_frame is unsupported

x-generation-modes.rule: end_frame requires start_frame. Frames cannot be combined with ordinary images, videos, or audio. Grok Imagine 1.5 requires start_frame and rejects end_frame.

x-generation-modes.name: Video reference
x-generation-modes.rule: Seedance 2.5 accepts up to 10 files totaling 30.2 seconds. Kling O3 Omni accepts one 3-10.05 second file and up to four images; duration must match the file within 0.05 seconds and 2160p is unavailable. FLUX 3 Video accepts one file up to 50 MB and 15.05 seconds; Seedance 2.0 models accept 3 files totaling 15 seconds. Cannot be combined with start_frame or end_frame.

x-generation-modes.name: Audio reference
x-generation-modes.rule: Seedance 2.5 accepts up to 10 files totaling 30.2 seconds and requires an image or video. Seedance 2.0 models accept one audio file totaling 15 seconds. MiniMax H3 requires an ordinary image and accepts three totaling 15 seconds.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required unique value for one paid business operation. Reuse it only when retrying the identical request body. A missing value returns idempotency_key_required; a value over 255 characters returns idempotency_key_too_long.

ImageSize.description: auto or WIDTHxHEIGHT. gpt-image-2 requires Leonardo width/height enums, ratio <= 3:1, and 655360..8294400 pixels. Nano Banana 2/Pro require Leonardo width/height enums. Seedream 5.0 Pro accepts custom integer edges from 768 through 2048 inclusive; its standard UI presets are enumerated in x-model-rules.

cost.two_k_condition: width>=2016 and height>=1153, or width>=1153 and height>=2016

ImageQuantity.description: Number of images returned by this gateway in one request.

ImageRequest.description: Strict public image DTO. Leonardo-native prompt_enhance/style_ids, internal references, and Nano Banana 2 video_reference_base are not exposed and are rejected as unknown fields.

quality.description: gpt-image-2 only. auto is normalized to low by this gateway; Leonardo's native schema default is MEDIUM.

ImageEstimateRequest.description: Image pricing inputs only. size accepts auto or a model-valid WIDTHxHEIGHT; quality is accepted only for gpt-image-2; n is the requested image quantity.

quality.description: gpt-image-2 only; auto is normalized to low. Other models reject quality.

quality.description: Normalized GPT quality; omitted for models without a quality parameter.

estimated_tokens.description: unit_tokens multiplied by quantity; this is the reservation amount.

pricing_anchor.description: Internal pricing bucket used to select the active rule.

quality_multiplier.description: GPT Image 2 multiplier: low=1, medium=8.833, high=35.167.

cost_parameters.description: Request fields that can change the estimate for this model.

KlingO3OmniSize.description: Exact Leonardo output dimensions. Each size is tied to the 720p, 1080p, or 2160p price tier.

KlingO3OmniDimensionRules.description: Enforces the Kling O3 Omni size-to-resolution price tier mapping when both fields are present.

GrokImagine15Size.description: Exact Leonardo output dimensions. Each size is tied to one resolution price tier.

KlingO3OmniVideoEstimateRequest.description: Kling O3 Omni estimate. When has_video_reference=true, duration is the reference-video duration used for pricing; it must be 3-10 seconds and the selected tier cannot be 2160p.

GrokImagine15VideoEstimateRequest.description: Grok Imagine 1.5 cost estimate. size and resolution must belong to the same tier; either field may be omitted and is inferred by the gateway.

generate_audio.description: Controls native output audio. The current Leonardo tokens price is unchanged when false.

VideoReferenceRequest.description: Multipart request with one or more model-supported reference fields; there is no mode field. Seedance may combine image, video, and audio; Kling O3 Omni accepts up to seven images, start/end frames, or one video plus up to four images; FLUX 3 Video accepts either start/end frames or one video continuation file; MiniMax H3 may combine image and audio. start_frame is required for frame input, end_frame is optional where supported and requires start_frame, and either frame field is exclusive with image, video, and audio. Grok Imagine 1.5 requires start_frame and rejects every other reference field. Audio requires the model-specific supporting reference documented on the audio property.

video.description: MP4, MOV, or WebM; file size must not exceed 50 MB and duration must not exceed 15.05 seconds.
MP4, MOV, or WebM; combined duration must not exceed 15 seconds.

audio.description: One file totaling no more than 15 seconds; requires image or video.

video.description: MP4, MOV, or WebM; combined duration must not exceed 15 seconds.

audio.description: One file totaling no more than 15 seconds; requires image or video.

Seedance25ReferenceRequest.description: Seedance 2.5 multipart request. Ordinary image, video, and audio references may be combined. start_frame with optional end_frame is a separate mode and is exclusive with those reference fields. Audio requires at least one ordinary image or video reference.

video.description: MP4, MOV, or WebM; combined duration must not exceed 30.2 seconds.

audio.description: Combined duration must not exceed 30.2 seconds; requires an ordinary image or video reference.

Veo31FrameReferenceRequest.description: Frame-reference request. start_frame is required; end_frame is optional.

Veo31FastReferenceRequest.description: Frame-reference request. start_frame is required; end_frame is optional.

KlingO3OmniReferenceRequest.description: Kling O3 Omni multipart request. Use up to seven ordinary images, start_frame with optional end_frame, or one reference video with up to four ordinary images. Frame guidance is exclusive with ordinary images and video. Reference video duration must be within 0.05 seconds of the integer duration field.

video.description: One MP4, MOV, or WebM reference. Duration 3-10.05 seconds; each edge 720-2160 pixels; 2160p output is unsupported. The duration field must match the uploaded file within 0.05 seconds.

audio.description: Combined duration must not exceed 15 seconds.

MiniMaxH3FrameReferenceRequest.description: Frame-reference request. start_frame is required; end_frame is optional.

GrokImagine15ReferenceRequest.description: Grok Imagine 1.5 is image-to-video only. start_frame is required; end_frame, ordinary image references, reference video, and reference audio are unsupported.

generate_audio.description: Controls native output audio. The current Leonardo tokens price is unchanged when false.

ChatCompletionRequest.description: The final user message becomes an image prompt. Its combined text is limited by the selected image model and is rejected before task admission when too long.
